channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS IAM extends trusted identity propagation to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, and simplifies it in IAM Identity Center
item.description: Trusted identity propagation (TIP) carries the identity of a human user or workload with requests to supported AWS Services. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Rust 1.100 Ships the Never Type After Ten Years and Five Failed Attempts
item.description: Rust 1.100.0, released 12 November 2026, stabilises the never type (!) after ten years of work and makes Infallible an alias for it. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock adds bedrock-runtime endpoint support for OpenAI Daybreak Red in AWS GovCloud (US)
item.description: Eligible customers can now access OpenAI’s specialized cybersecurity models Daybreak Red: GPT-5.6 Cyber through the bedrock-runtime endpoint on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless is now available in the Africa (Cape Town) Region
item.description: Starting today, the next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless is available in the AWS Africa (Cape Town) Region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS CloudFormation makes resource coverage comprehensive with 206 new types
item.description: AWS CloudFormation now supports 206 additional resource types across 88 services, including Amazon SageMaker Hub, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore PolicyEngine, and Amazon EC2 Snapshot. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer dashboards now support grouping historical metrics by time interval
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer analytics dashboards now support grouping historical metrics by time interval on trailing widgets, giving contact center managers granular control over how performance data is visualized over time. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon RDS for SQL Server now supports up to 500 databases per instance
item.description: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for SQL Server now supports up to 500 databases per DB instance, up from the previous limit of 100. (1 source: aws)
